# Seald

> Seald is a web application for electronic signatures. It runs in the browser. There is no native app.

Seald lets a person upload a PDF, place signature and form fields, sign it themselves or request signatures from other people, and download a sealed PDF. Seals use the PAdES long-term validation profile (ETSI EN 319 142), an RFC 3161 trusted timestamp from an external authority, and a tamper-evident SHA-256 audit trail. Documents can be checked on the public verification page. Templates remember fields, signers, and signing order.

Support: support@seald.nromomentum.com.

## Product

- Platform: web only, at https://seald.nromomentum.com
- Category: business e-signature application
- Not offered as a native mobile or desktop app
- Sign a PDF yourself, or request signatures in parallel or in order
- Type, draw, or upload a signature
- Reusable templates
- PAdES-LT seals, RFC 3161 timestamps, SHA-256 audit trail
- Public verification of a sealed document
- TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest
